description: Highnoon Laboratories Limited was incorporated in March 1984 as a private limited company in Lahore, and became a public limited company by 1995. It develops, produces, markets and distributes medicines, describing a portfolio of more than 50 products in different drug forms. Its therapeutic areas, as listed on its own site, are cardiology, metabolic, gastroenterology, musculoskeletal, anti-infective, obstetrics and gynaecology, paediatrics, allergy, respiratory and urology.
